result.topic_en: Euler discusses how the tone of an elastic rod of rectangular or circular cross-section depends on the axis of bending, notes possible further cases with intermediate fixed points, and states Problem §47 on a rod simply fixed at both ends and also pinned at an intermediate point.

enim $b$ pendet, vti iam ſupra notauimus, ab elaſticitate
abſoluta materiae, ex qua virgae ſunt fabricatae. Ita ſi
virga, cuius longitudo eſt $= a$, incuruetur circa axem A B,
ſonus editus erit vt $\frac{AC}{aa}$; at ſi virga incuruetur circa axem
A C, ſonus editus erit vt $\frac{AB}{aa}$, ſi ſcilicet reliquae circum-

rit circulus, diametro A B deſcriptus (fig. 6.), tum pro
formulis noſtris erit $c = \frac{3}{4}$ A B; vbi perinde eſt, circa quem-
nam axem fiat incuruatio. Hic quidem alios caſus non
ſumus contemplati, niſi in quibus ambo virgae termini
vel ſunt liberi, vel ſimpliciter fixi, vel firmiter infixi. Fie-
ri autem poſſet vt eadem virga inſuper in vno vel plu-
ribus locis mediis ſimpliciter figatur, quandoquidem hoc
pacto communicatio inter motus diuerſarum partium non
tolleretur: ſed omnium huiusmodi caſuum euolutio re-
quireret tractationem infinitam. Vt autem ratio, calculum
ad huiusmodi caſum applicandi, intelligatur, ſufficiet vnum
talem caſum hic ſubiunxiſſe.

Problema.

§. 47. Si virga elaſtica non ſolum in vtroque termino
E et F fuerit ſimpliciter fixa, ſed etiam in puncto quocun-
que medio L ope ſtyli figatur, inueſtigare omnes motus, qui-
bus iſta virga contremiſcere poteſt.

So-

Ita ſi
virga, cuius longitudo eſt $= a$, incuruetur circa axem A B,
ſonus editus erit vt $\frac{AC}{aa}$; at ſi virga incuruetur circa axem
A C, ſonus editus erit vt $\frac{AB}{aa}$, ſi ſcilicet reliquae circum-

items.english: Thus if a rod of length a is bent about the axis AB, the emitted tone will be as AC/aa; but if the rod is bent about the axis AC, the tone will be as AB/aa, provided the other circumstances are equal.

items.quote:
At ſi ſectio virgae transverſalis fue-
rit circulus, diametro A B deſcriptus (fig. 6.), tum pro
formulis noſtris erit $c = \frac{3}{4}$ A B; vbi perinde eſt, circa quem-
nam axem fiat incuruatio.
items.english: But if the transverse section of the rod is a circle described with diameter AB (fig. 6), then for our formulas c = 3/4 AB, and it makes no difference about which axis the bending occurs.

items.english: If an elastic rod is not only simply fixed at both ends E and F but is also pinned by a pin at any intermediate point L, to investigate all the motions by which this rod can vibrate.
